findings.title: Badge-notification color in categories list still uses a lightness-only scale-color
findings.body: The PR title says scale-color $lightness must use $secondary for dark themes, but in this file the `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` rule (line 115) still uses plain scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) and was not converted, unlike the other color rules in the same file. On dark themes this leaves the text color inconsistent with the rest of the list.

findings.title: Duplicate selector for thumb-tack unpinned changed without need
findings.body: The `.fa-thumb-tack.unpinned` rule was converted to dark-light-choose but it is a redundant duplicate of the parent rule; not a functional bug, but the change adds more noise to a rule already covered by line 39.

findings.title: h3 color in topic-map changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: In `.topic-map h3` the base color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) and the diff replaces it with the 50% lightness value for the light branch, silently changing the light theme color of mobile topic map headings. The lightness value should stay 20% for the primary branch, otherwise the visual change is unintended and not described by the PR.

findings.title: group-member-info .name lightness changed from 30% to 50% silently
findings.body: The `.group-member-info .name` color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) and was changed to the 50% primary value on the light branch, altering the light theme appearance without any documented intent. Same unintended-change issue as the other lightness rewrites.

findings.title: group-member-info .name color lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The `.group-member-info .name` primary color was changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) to scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), changing the light-theme color that the PR is supposed to leave alone for light themes.

findings.title: custom-message-length primary lightness changed from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The light-theme branch of `.custom-message-length` was changed from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) to 30%, making the counter text much darker on light themes. This is a visible regression not matching the PR's stated purpose of only adding a dark-theme fallback.

findings.title: Duplicate lightness changed for topic-map h5 link
findings.body: In the embedded-posts `.topic-meta-data h5 a` rule the light branch was changed from 30% to 70% lightness, a different shade than the rest of the file's conventions; the change is undocumented and reverses the emphasis direction.

findings.title: Embedded topic-meta-data h5 link lightness changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: The `.topic-meta-data h5 a` color light branch changed from scale-color($primary,$lightness:30%) to 70%, making the link much lighter on light themes; this is an unrequested visual change.
